nodes.description: Constructor of DropPartyNFT initializing ERC721 metadata, PaymentSplitter payees/shares, MAX_NFTS and REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Public string holding the provenance hash of the collection.
Block number used as entropy source for the starting token index.
Pseudo-random offset used to shuffle token reveal order.
Maximum number of NFTs that can ever be minted.
Flag controlling whether minting is currently enabled.
Timestamp after which the starting index block can be set by anyone.
Constant price per NFT (0.08 ETH) used to validate msg.value.
Constant maximum number of NFTs mintable per transaction (20).
Owner-only function minting up to 30 reserved NFTs to the caller.
Owner-only setter for REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Owner-only setter for the provenance hash.
Owner-only setter for the ERC721 base URI.
Owner-only toggle of the saleIsActive flag.
Payable public mint function that validates sale state, per-tx limit, supply and payment, then mints NFTs.
Public function deriving startingIndex from blockhash, vulnerable to miner manipulation.
Owner-only fallback to set startingIndexBlock when it was never set.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, payouts, ownership checks and callbacks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to decide when the starting index block can be set.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract before mint state is fully settled for the caller, allowing callback reentrancy.
Address.sendValue performs a forwarded-gas low-level call to msg.sender, enabling reentrancy on release().
startingIndex is computed from blockhash of a known block, a predictable entropy source controllable by miners.
PaymentSplitter pull-payment function transferring owed Ether to the caller.
Total shares held by all payees in PaymentSplitter.
Total amount of Ether already released in PaymentSplitter.
Mapping of account to amount already released in PaymentSplitter.
Caller-supplied number of NFTs to mint in mintNFT.
New reveal timestamp passed to setRevealTimestamp.
Provenance hash passed to setProvenanceHash.
Base URI string passed to setBaseURI.
Maximum NFT supply supplied to the constructor.
Sale start timestamp supplied to the constructor.
Cached totalSupply() in reserveNFTs.
Loop counter in reserveNFTs.
Token id computed from totalSupply() inside mintNFT loop.
Loop counter in mintNFT.
Amount owed to the caller computed in release.
Contract balance plus already released total in release.
ERC721Enumerable total supply getter used for supply checks and mint indices.
Mapping of account to assigned shares in PaymentSplitter.

edges.reason: numberOfTokens feeds nftPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) and totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) arithmetic checks.
revealTimeStamp is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
provenanceHash is written into PARTY_PROVENANCE.
baseURI is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
maxNftSupply initializes MAX_NFTS.
saleStart is used to compute REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
supply holds totalSupply() used as mint index base.
Loop counter i drives the reserve mint loop.
mintIndex is passed as tokenId to _safeMint.
Loop counter i drives the mintNFT mint loop.
payment is computed with unchecked subtraction/multiplication and forwarded to sendValue.
totalReceived is derived from address(this).balance plus _totalReleased.
Constructor assigns MAX_NFTS.
Constructor computes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from saleStart.
onlyOwner function overwrites REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
onlyOwner function overwrites PARTY_PROVENANCE.
onlyOwner function toggles saleIsActive.
mintNFT reads saleIsActive as a guard.
mintNFT writes startingIndexBlock when supply is exhausted or reveal time passed.
Supply cap check compares totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) with MAX_NFTS.
setStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as entropy.
Modulo and add operations against MAX_NFTS in setStartingIndex.
onlyOwner emergency function sets startingIndexBlock.
reserveNFTs reads totalSupply() to compute mint indices.
mintNFT repeatedly reads totalSupply() for supply checks and indices.
startingIndex is produced by the blockhash-based entropy computation.
msg.sender is the recipient of minted tokens and payer.
reserveNFTs is restricted by onlyOwner comparing owner() to _msgSender().
onlyOwner gate on setRevealTimestamp depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gate on setProvenanceHash depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gate on setBaseURI depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gate on flipSaleState depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gate on emergencySetStartingIndexBlock depends on msg.sender.
msg.sender is the payee whose shares/released balances are read and who receives Ether.
block.timestamp compared to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP decides when startingIndexBlock is fixed.
block.number/blockhash timing influences the pseudo-random index derivation.
mintNFT calls _safeMint which invokes the receiver hook on an untrusted contract address.
onERC721Received callback is executed on msg.sender-controlled recipient contract.
release() calls Address.sendValue which performs a forwarded-gas low-level call.
Low-level value call transfers control to the untrusted msg.sender before state is final.
release reads _shares[msg.sender] to compute the payment.
release uses _totalShares as the denominator.
release reads and updates _released[msg.sender].
release accumulates payment into _totalReleased.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter numberOfTokens is only meaningful inside mintNFT's arithmetic and mint loop.
Parameter revealTimeStamp is only used to update REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in setRevealTimestamp.
Parameter provenanceHash is only used to update PARTY_PROVENANCE in setProvenanceHash.
Parameter baseURI is only forwarded to _setBaseURI inside setBaseURI.
Parameter maxNftSupply only initializes MAX_NFTS in the constructor.
Parameter saleStart only participates in REVEAL_TIMESTAMP computation in the constructor.
Local supply caches totalSupply() solely inside reserveNFTs.
Local loop counter i exists only inside reserveNFTs.
Local mintIndex is computed and consumed only inside mintNFT.
Local loop counter i exists only inside mintNFT.
Local payment is computed and sent only inside release.
Local totalReceived is computed only inside release.
